'''Electro-mines''' were [[Mine/Legends|mines]] that emitted electric charges across certain distances. If the charge or the electro-mine came into contact with anything, it would explode.

==History==
Electro-mines were used as a security defense to guard the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]]. There were several of them placed on a vertical wall surrounding the landing platform. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]] was [[Capture of Even Piell/Legends|captured]] and imprisoned in the Citadel. A rescue team of [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] encountered these electro-mines when they were scaling the vertical wall to the entrance to the Citadel. They had almost made to the platform but a [[Charger/Legends|clone]] lost his balance and fell down the cliff, getting caught in the electric charge and setting off the mine, [[Death/Legends|killing]] the clone and alerting the Citadel guards to the Jedi and clones' presence.

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Cartoon Network]] dataclip for the episode "The Citadel" displays the name as electro mine, without the hyphen. However, the subtitles in the episode itself did hyphenate the name.
